Flanking Georgian and Victorian tenements showcase dark Scottish slate roofs, rhythmic rows of stone chimney stacks with ceramic pots, lead-flashed dormers, and multi-pane sash windows. In the immediate foreground, a red-brick tenement gable wall with sandstone quoins and lead-trimmed flat parapets shows subtle freeze-thaw surface texture.
